query:
UPDATE issues
               SET title = $2, description = $3, status_id = $4, priority = $5,
                   sort_order = $6, parent_issue_id = $7, parent_issue_sort_order = $8,
                   external_id = $9, mode = $10, budget_usd = $11, completed_at = $12,
                   updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
               WHERE id = $1
